name: ion
description: Open-source agent harness for xAI Grok — Cursor-style desktop app supporting API key or SuperGrok OAuth

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ion/agent && npm run typecheck -w @ion/xai && npm run typecheck -w @ion/proxy && npm run typecheck -w @ion/desktop
scripts.smoke: tsx scripts/smoke-agent.ts && tsx scripts/smoke-xai.ts && tsx scripts/smoke-tools.ts && tsx scripts/smoke-oauth.ts && tsx scripts/smoke-proxy.ts
